ety.text: A post-Mongol invasion – attested first in the Praying of Daniel the Immured – Turkic borrowing of a form bōr or būr applied to bay horses, found in Chagatai بور (bōr, “bay horse”), ultimately of Iranian origin equivalent to Middle Persian [script needed] (bwl /⁠bōr⁠/, “reddish-brown, bay”), Persian بور (bôr).
